name: Bailey's Dictionary
author: Nathan Bailey
description: Sample entries from 'An Universal Etymological English Dictionary' (1721). Bailey's dictionary was the most popular English dictionary before Johnson's.

entries.definition: A Dictionary, or Book explaining hard Words.
A sort of Grain well known.
A Protector, a Defender; one who maintains or supports another.
A settled yearly Allowance for Maintenance.
An inland Imposition upon several Commodities.
An Inspiration, or extraordinary Emotion of the Mind, particularly that which Poets are said to be possess'd with, when they compose Verses; also a vain Conceit of being inspired.
The Understanding; a Faculty of the Mind; also Fancy, or an Aptness to say pleasant Things.
Work made in the form of a Net.
New, strange; also a short pleasant History or Tale.
A Name given to those who are for the Court and prerogative.
A Name given to those who are against the Court.
A Trial, Proof, or Attempt; also a short Treatise or Discourse.
A heavy Stick; also a Meeting of several Persons for Diversion.
The Power of the Mind whereby it represents to itself Things absent; also a Fancy or Notion.
A good or evil Spirit or Angel that is supposed to attend upon every Person; also a natural Inclination or Disposition of Mind.
Report, Rumour, Renown.
The Expectation of some future Good.
A Passion of the Mind, caused by the Apprehension of some Evil to come.
An Affection of the Mind towards some Object; also Friendship, Charity.
A Habit of the Mind conformable to right Reason; also Courage, Power, Efficacy.
The essential Property of a Thing; also the Course of Things; also Disposition or Temper.
Skill or Knowledge in any thing; also Trade or Occupation; also Cunning, Craft.
Knowledge, Learning; a Body of Arts or Rules relating to some particular Subject.
The Knowledge of natural and moral Things, and their Causes.
Freedom from Slavery, Captivity, or Restraint; also Privilege, Leave.
One of the four Cardinal Virtues; also Equity, Right; also the Power of executing Laws.
A Book that explains the Words of any Language alphabetically.
The Art of speaking and writing a Language correctly.
The true Original or Derivation of a Word.
Speech, Tongue; also Style or manner of Expression.
